Icon deliberately ignores current-era Liquid Glass conventions (no glass layers, no Icon Composer variants evident) — a flat brand-mark, hence era=custom not liquid-glass. Cover art confirms a light-neutral moodboard/reference-library UI; the black monochrome icon is a high-contrast counterpoint to the pale chrome — coherent by restraint, not by shared hue. Cannot confirm whether the shipping app ships a proper layered/tintable asset; the flat render can't show layer separation, so #10 scored on what was delivered.
